question: Should device-scoped hosted-wizard recovery accept only `pairedClientId` as its device identity, with raw `connect.device.id` excluded unless Gateway authentication proves it is canonical?
rationale: The intended ownership boundary determines whether reconnect recovery can safely expose retained setup work; the code and type contract point to the verified paired identifier, but changing identity selection may affect existing hosted clients.

options.title: Use verified pairing identity
options.body: Use `pairedClientId` for device-scoped recovery and reject or connection-scope callers that lack a server-verified reconnect identity.

options.title: Retain raw device identity
options.body: Keep `connect.device.id` only after documenting and proving that Gateway validation canonicalizes it before this resolver runs.

recommendation.title: Use verified pairing identity
recommendation.body: Use `pairedClientId` for device-scoped recovery and reject or connection-scope callers that lack a server-verified reconnect identity.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the hosted-wizard owner and recovery lifecycle proposed by the PR.
